general: Dossier items (dossieritems) are the records that hang in AFAS on an employee, relation, project or invoice: correspondence, appointments, complaints, notifications and the attachments with them. Scanned purchase invoices also come along as a dossier item.

Each row is one dossier item. The column Type bestemming (destination type) determines what the item hangs on, and therefore which column below must be filled: for destination Medewerker the Medewerker column, for Organisatie/persoon the Organisatie of persoon column.
If you want to bring along documents, every row with a file name must also have the file itself supplied. Agree with Nymbus how the attachments will be transferred.
The columns below are derived from the AFAS specification of the dossier item (UpdateConnector KnSubject). The import template for this module is still to be delivered.

Type dossieritem.description: The number of the dossier item type, which determines what kind of record this is — for example a complaint, an appointment or a scanned invoice. The available types are set up in the AFAS environment; agree with Nymbus which numbers apply to this conversion.

Onderwerp.description: The title of the dossier item: what it is about in one line. This is what users see in the dossier in AFAS. Maximum 255 characters.

Toelichting.description: The full text or explanation of the dossier item. A longer description can be included here; line breaks are retained.
Toelichting.example: Delivery was incomplete; the supplier has promised to deliver the remainder.

Instuurdatum.description: The date on which the dossier item was created or submitted. In a conversion this is the original date from the source system, not the date of conversion. Format DD-MM-JJJJ or DD/MM/JJJJ.

Instuurder.description: The name or number of the person who submitted the dossier item. Maximum 80 characters.

Verantwoordelijke.description: The name or number of the person who must handle the dossier item. Maximum 80 characters.

Prioriteit.description: How urgent the item is: H = Hoog (high), N = Normaal (normal), L = Laag (low). Leave empty to use the standard priority of the type.

Begindatum.description: The date on which the item takes effect or the action starts. Leave empty when only the submission date matters. Format DD-MM-JJJJ or DD/MM/JJJJ.

Einddatum.description: The date on which the item expires or the action must be completed at the latest. May not be earlier than the start date. Format DD-MM-JJJJ or DD/MM/JJJJ.

Afgehandeld.description: Whether the dossier item is completed (Ja) or still open (Nee). With Ja the date of handling is required; with Nee it must be left empty.

Datum afgehandeld.description: The date on which the item was handled. Only to be filled in when Afgehandeld is Ja, and not earlier than the submission date. Format DD-MM-JJJJ or DD/MM/JJJJ.

Type bestemming.description: What the dossier item hangs on, as a code: 1 = Geen (none), 2 = Medewerker (employee), 3 = Organisatie/persoon (organisation/person), 4 = Verkooprelatie (sales relation), and further 8, 9, 10, 11, 17 and 66 for the other destinations. This column determines which of the columns below must be filled.

Bestemming.description: The free designation of the destination, for destination types that have no own column in this template. Leave empty when you use Medewerker or Organisatie of persoon. Maximum 50 characters.

Organisatie of persoon.description: The number of the organisation or person to which the item hangs. Required with Type bestemming 3. Maximum 15 characters.

Medewerker.description: The employee number to which the item hangs. Required with Type bestemming 2, and must match the conversion of the Employees module. Maximum 15 characters.

Projectnummer.description: The project to which the dossier item hangs, when it is project-bound. Maximum 15 characters.

Contractnummer.description: The contract to which the dossier item hangs, when it belongs to a contract. Must match the conversion of the Financial contracts module. Maximum 16 characters.

Organisatorische eenheid.description: The organisational unit under which the item falls. Checked against the organisational unit table from the AFAS environment of this project. Maximum 10 characters.

Geblokkeerd.description: Whether the dossier item is blocked for further editing (Ja) or is simply accessible (Nee).

Bestandsnaam bijlage.description: The name of the attached file, including extension. If there is a file name here, the file itself must also be supplied; agree with Nymbus how. Maximum 255 characters.
